source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-12 from the table's own CA(130;4,167,2) (table/arrays/CA_130_4_167_2.txt, submission smolen-2026-11-t4-130at167, sha256 3488ce29cad2349d27d23416623deb8c4f6d5e1e17d088d2590bf6ef0579754c). Two new columns of 130 entries were each chosen by simulated annealing to minimise the triples of columns and patterns whose covering rows the new column leaves single-valued (programs/colopt.c, arguments 167 130 15 0.5 40000, seeds 5 and 6). One row of 169 random entries (Python random.seed(1)) was appended, giving 131 rows with 89 uncovered patterns on sets of four columns. An exact repair that flips single cells anywhere in the array and keeps exact incremental lists of uncovered and uniquely covered patterns (programs/repi4.c, seed 1, temperature 0.25, 1 thread) reached 0 after 721 accepted flips. programs/recipe.sh runs every step; a complete run from scratch reproduced the array exactly (programs/recipe_log.txt). Exact check with ca_verify, all 4-sets
construction: Column extension of CA(130;4,167,2) by two columns chosen by simulated annealing and one added row, finished by exact single-cell repair
notes: answers the cited size 131 at k = 169 (tie); built from the table's own CA(130;4,167,2); no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start
